category: operator precedence slip in a unit conversion (x / A * B where x / (A * B) was meant); wrong values surface only in the reporting package
issue: Every figure we print in hours is coming out as the raw number of seconds. A project with 4h45m logged shows up in the weekly report as "acme: 4h45m (17100.0h)" - the duration text printed beside it is right, only the hours number is wrong. The same thing happens to a single entry: 1h15m reports 4500.0 hours instead of 1.25, and the overtime figure against a 1 hour cap says 18000.0 rather than 5.0. Totals expressed in seconds, the per-day and per-project breakdowns, and everything the parser and formatter do are all correct.
